node_scale.source: 自估:45 → 65 nm 的 CV² 换算,尺寸比 65/45 ≈ 1.44 × 电压比平方 (1.2/1.0)² = 1.44,约 2.07,取 2.0;无外部出处。memristor 侧 65 nm 周边按 V_dd = 1.0 V 取,故对数字侧是偏高端的估计

E_mul8.source: Horowitz, Computing's energy problem (and what we can do about it), ISSCC 2014, 45 nm: int8 add 0.03 pJ, int8 mult 0.2 pJ, int16 add 0.05 pJ, int32 add 0.1 pJ, 8 KB SRAM 10 pJ/64 b, 1 MB SRAM 100 pJ/64 b, DRAM 1.3–2.6 nJ/64 b;本项 = int8 mult 0.2 pJ × node_scale 2.0

E_add16.source: Horowitz, Computing's energy problem (and what we can do about it), ISSCC 2014, 45 nm: int8 add 0.03 pJ, int8 mult 0.2 pJ, int16 add 0.05 pJ, int32 add 0.1 pJ, 8 KB SRAM 10 pJ/64 b, 1 MB SRAM 100 pJ/64 b, DRAM 1.3–2.6 nJ/64 b;本项 = int16 add 0.05 pJ × node_scale 2.0
